test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question: The main focus of this report is on:

options.text: the scene created by the gas well blowout
the damage to the biodiversity and wildlife that the blowout has caused
what a gas well blowout is and how it occurs
the measures being employed by the gas company to control the blow out

solution:
The correct answer is** "the damage to the biodiversity and wildlife that the blowout has caused"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** 

 
• The **theme **of the passage is about the** blowout of Oil India Limited leading to damage to biodiversity and wildlife of the region.**

**Hence, the correct answer is option 2**
